questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. No powder is a solid.

2. All lotions are solids.

3. All gases are lotions. 

**Conclusions:**

I. No solid is a gas.

II. No gas is a powder.

III. No lotion is a powder.

IV. Some powders are lotions.

options.text: Only conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I, II and IV follow
Only conclusions II, III and IV follow

questions.solution:
**Logic: **We have to draw a Venn diagram and analyse the statements.

The minimum possible Venn diagram for the given condition is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b8eaa3ec3e0d37d3871db7bf08a6205c99e8482e07b42cfef4346ad7e997704.png] 

Now, we have to analyse the statements.

**Conclusions:**

**I. No solid is a gas.**

**False. **As some portion of solid is overlapping with gas.

**II. No gas is a powder**.

**True. **As Gas is a part of a Solid and solid can't be Powder.

**III. No lotion is a powder.**

True. As Lotion is a part of Solid and solid can't be Powder.

**IV. Some powders are lotions.**

**False. **As no part of Powder is overlapping with Lotion.

As it can be seen that only conclusion 2 and 3 are right.

Therefore, the direct answer should be **"Only conclusions II and III follow".

After applying the combination the equation becomes:

→ 252 ÷ 9 × 5 + 32 - 92 = 200.

→ 28 × 5 + 32 - 92.

→ 140 + 32 - 92.

→ 172 - 92.

→ 80 ≠ 200.

For, **"Option2: −, ×, ÷, +".**

→ 252 - 9 × 5 ÷ 32 + 92 = 200.

→ 252 - 9 × 0.156 + 92.

→ 252 - 1.40 + 92.

→ 252 - 90.59.

→ 161.40 ≠ 200.

**→ 252 ÷ 9 × 5 - 32 + 92 = 200. **

**→ 28 × 5 - 32 + 92.**

**→ 140 - 32 + 92.**

**→ 232 - 32**

**→ 200 = 200.**

→ 252 × 9 ÷ 5 - 32 + 92 = 200. 

→ 252 × 1.8 - 32 + 92.

→ 453.6 - 32 + 92.

→ 453.6 + 60.

→ 393.6 ≠ 200.

As it can be seen the only **"**Option3: ÷, ×, −, +". 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"****÷, ×, −, +". **

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

27 + 11 × 9 - 36 ÷ 4 = 67
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

Given equation, 27 + 11 × 9 - 36 ÷ 4 = 67

Option (1): 11 and 27

After the interchange, the new equation is-

⇒ 11 + 27 × 9 - 36 ÷ 4 = 67

⇒ 11 + 27 × 9 - 9 = 67

⇒ 254 - 9 = 67

⇒ 245 ≠ 67

**Option (2): 4 and 9**

**Given equation, 27 + 11 × 9 - 36 ÷ 4 = 67**

**After the interchange, the new equation is-**

**27 + 11 × 4 - 36 ÷ 9 = 67**

According to BODMAS rule,

**27 + 11 × 4 - 4 = 67**

**27 + 44 - 4 = 67**

**67 = 67**

Option (3): 11 and 36

Given equation, 27 + 11 × 9 - 36 ÷ 4 = 67

After the interchange, the new equation is-

⇒ 27 + 36 × 9 - 11 ÷ 4 = 67

⇒ 27 + 36 × 9 - 2.75 = 67

⇒ 27 + 324 - 2.75 = 67

⇒ 351 - 2.75 = 67

⇒ 348.25 ≠ 67

Option (4): 27 and 36

Given equation, 27 + 11 × 9 - 36 ÷ 4 = 67

After the interchange, the new equation is-

⇒ 36 + 27 × 9 - 11 ÷ 4 = 67

⇒ 36 + 27 × 9 - 2.75 = 67

⇒ 36 + 243 - 2.75 = 67

⇒ 279 - 2.75 = 67

⇒ 276.25 ≠ 67

Hence,** Option (2)** is correct.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

3 13 5

11 27 4

21 75 ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Middle number = {(first number + third number) × 2} - 3.

Row-wise operation :

Row 1:

⇒ Middle number = {(3 + 5) × 2} - 3

⇒ Middle number = {(8) × 2} - 3

⇒ Middle number = 16 - 3

⇒ Middle number = 13

Row 2:

⇒ Middle number = {(11 + 4) × 2} - 3

⇒ Middle number = {(15) × 2} - 3

⇒ Middle number = 30 - 3

⇒ Middle number = 27

Similarly,

**Row 3:**

**⇒ 75 = {(21 + ?) × 2} - 3**

**⇒ 75 + 3 = {(21 + ?) × 2}**

**⇒ 78 = {(21 + ?) × 2}**

**⇒ 78 ÷ 2 = (21 + ?)**

**⇒ 39 = (21 + ?)**

**⇒ ? = 39 - 21**

**⇒ ? = 18**

Hence, **Option (3) **is correct.

• Rickets is a childhood disorder of the bones where the bones become soft and prone to fractures. Bones tend to become weak due to an inadequate supply of nutrients, Vitamin D in particular.
 
• It is also caused due to a lack of calcium and phosphate in the body. Weak bones can lead to bone deformities. Vitamin D largely comes from exposing the skin to sunlight.
 
• Other good sources of Vitamin D are fatty fish (such as tuna and salmon) and egg yolks.
 
• **Rickets is a disease associated with the deficiency of Vitamin D.**
 
• Rickets is of the following types:
 
 
• Nutritiona**l Rickets–**
 
 
• This is caused due to intake of food which lacks calcium, phosphorous, and vitamin D.
 
 
 
• Hypophosphatemic** Rickets**-
 
 
• It is caused due to low levels of phosphate. It is an X-linked genetic disorder where the kidneys are not able to control the amount of phosphate excreted in the urine.
 
 
 
• Renal** Rickets-**
 
 
• People suffering from kidney disorders have renal** rickets.** They are unable to regulate the amount of calcium and phosphate excreted in the urine.

questions.question: Midhun smashes 96 runs against Zimbabwe in 18 balls. If he scored his runs by hitting fours and sixes only, then find the maximum percentage of runs he scored by hitting fours.
questions.solution:
**Midhun smashes 96 runs against Zimbabwe in 18 balls. If he scored his runs by hitting fours and sixes only.**

then to score 96 runs in 18 balls by 4s and 6s only. No. of 4s will be equal to 6 and No. of 6s will be equal to 12.

Total smashed runs by 4s = 4 × 6 = 24

Total smashed runs by 6s = 6 × 12 = 72

Total Smashed run is 72 + 24 = 96 in 18 balls.

Maximum percentage of runs scored by hitting 4s = ( Total runs smashed by 4s ÷ Total runs ) × 100

Maximum percentage of runs scored by hitting 4s = ( 24 ÷ 96 ) × 100

**Maximum percentage of runs scored by hitting 4s** = **25%**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (2)"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the number of boundaries be x

So, 

4 × x + 6 × (18 - x) = 96

⇒ 4x + 108 - 6x = 96 

⇒ -2x = -12

⇒ x = 6

Total smashed runs by 4s = 4 × 6 = 24

Total smashed runs by 6s = 6(18 - 6) = 6 × 12 = 72

Total Smashed run is 72 + 24 = 96 in 18 balls.

Required % = 24/96 × 100 = 25%

**∴ The maximum percentage of runs he scored by hitting fours is 25%.**

questions.question:
Two Statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some vowels are digits.

2. Some digits are consonants.

**Conclusions:**

I. No consonant is a vowel.

II. No digit is a vowel.

III. Some consonants are vowels.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f635acdde3977e0da7ccb745a552d1597babf13988c5f26f20444ff361c950af.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No consonant is a vowel → Can't say as there is No clear relation is given between Vowel and consonants

II. No digit is a vowel → False → According to Statement 1.

III. Some consonants are vowels → False → (It is possible but not definite).

Both **conclusions I and III form a complementary pair**, hence either I or III follows.

Hence, **Option (4)** is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A set of two conclusions is said to be a Complementary Pair and thus form a case of **either or** when they follow the following conditions-

i) Both the objects must be the same in both conclusions.

ii) Both the conclusions must be False individually.

Some of the cases of complementary pairs are-

Some + No & All + Some Not 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

**Some + Some not **is never a complimentary pair.
